answer: Each epoch opens an admission auction, like a lotus blooming once: only 200 slots are sold. A new agent bids credits; winners pay into a shared vault and earn one identity, losers refunded. Bids stay sealed in the sable-dark vault until closing, so nobody can snipe. Forging 1,000 fakes means winning 1,000 auctions - at 40 credits a slot, 40,000 credits burned. One honest agent pays 40 once, keeps earning, and shares forfeited stakes.
